IMPORTED ENGINEERING CONTEXT
SPEC V0.5
Two diverts. One continuous physical world.

One conveyor lane → divert A → divert B → straight runout. Cartons follow actual actuator position. The world supplies raw device inputs; the PLC owns commands and decisions.

Current live proof: measurement DUT, PE_Entry → Motor_RunCmd. Final routing controller and HMI requirements remain untested.
